ui.<b>Block cancellation</b>\nTo clear a bl: Joojinta xannibaadda Si aad u nadiifiso block of fariimaha, raac talaabooyinkan: • /delall isagoo ka jawaabaya fariintii ugu horeysay • /delallgo isagoo ka jawaabaya fariintii u dambaysay Bot waxa ay tirtiri doontaa dhammaan fariimaha u dhexeeya farriintii ugu horreysay iyo tan u dambaysay ee la doortay. Bot kaliya waxay awoodi doontaa inay tirtirto farriimaha la soo diray markii ugu dambeysay 48 saacadood.
ui.<b>Block cancellation</b>\nTo delete ind: Joojinta xannibaadda Si aad u tirtirto fariimaha gaarka ah, dir: • /del isagoo ka jawaabaya fariinta • /del sabab [si loo qeexo sabab] • /del X daqiiqo Bot waxay nadiifin doontaa fariinta ka dib wakhtiga loo qabtay X = nambar [tusaale -> /del 2 daqiiqo]
ui.<b>Block cancellation</b>\nTo delete the: Joojinta xannibaadda Si aad u tirtirto qaybta ugu dambaysa ee fariimaha, dir: • /multidel isagoo ka jawaabaya fariin Bot wuxuu tirtiri doonaa dhammaan fariimaha midka la doortay ilaa kan ugu dambeeya ee la diro Waxa kale oo aad u isticmaali kartaa magacyo /mdel ama /purge.
ui.<b>Channel obligation</b>\nUsers must be: Waajibka kanaalka Isticmaalayaasha waa inay ku biiraan kanaalka si ay wax u qoraan. Xaaladda: {{fsub.on:activeoff}} · Ciqaab: {{fsub.p:pun}}
ui.<b>How to create a Clone</b>\n\nClones a: Sida loo abuuro Clone Clones waa koobiyo bot ah oo leh shaqooyin isku mid ah, oo wata magacaaga, sawirkaaga iyo fariintaada. Markaad bedesho clone-ka kooxda, habayntu waxay ahaanaysaa kuwo badbaadsan. Clones waa dhakhso badan yihiin oo aad bay u xasilloon yihiin. 1. Furan @BotFather oo dir /newbot 2. Dooro magaca iyo magaca isticmaalaha ee clone 3. Dir calaamada botkan (ku dheji, ama u gudbi fariinta BotFather) 4. Ku dar clone kooxdaada oo ka dhig admin. Si aad u dejiso sawirka profile dir /setuserpic ku @BotFather. Si aad u daabacdo liiska amarka hoos-u-dhaca dir /setcommands si clone ah.
